Nora (People Ops): Heads-up: Due to unexpected transit disruptions next week we9re running a short SF hub capacity plan. Please read and act if you9re planning to be onsite or expecting visitors. :warning:

Nora (People Ops): Key bullets: 1) preregistration for all external visitors (24h lead), 2) daily headcount cap 40, 3) teams will get assigned alternating hub days to spread load. Links: prereg form https://redwood.internal/forms/visitor-prereg and shuttle sign-up https://redwood.internal/shuttle/sf

Aisha (Eng): How will team-assigned days work?

Sam (People Ops): We9ll send a suggested rotation to team leads today — think A/B days (Mon/Wed/Fri vs Tue/Thu). Leads can swap but keep total capacity in mind.

Leo (Sales): If a customer is in town for a demo and needs extra desks, is there an override path?

Nora (People Ops): Sales/customer demos = exceptions possible. DM me with date, headcount, and sponsor. We9ll try to approve before midday.

Maya (Facilities): Security desk hours will be 8:30 18:30 for the pilot. After-hours escort required if you need late access.

IT Support: Loaner devices available for on-site contractors; open a ticket with subject "SF LOANER". We have 4 laptops and 2 test benches reserved for the week.

Security Bot: Reminder: all external visitors must complete the building NDA e-form before badge pickup. Link included in prereg confirmation email.

Aisha (Eng): Is hot-desk booking different?

Sam (People Ops): Book desks as normal. We9ve increased the booking window to 7 days for pilot participants and reserved a small block of desks for customer demos.

Leo (Sales): Catering for a customer lunch  any special rules?

Maya (Facilities): Catering requests need 72h lead and building-approved vendors only. Put vendor name in the request. For external guests we require sealed delivery to the lobby.

Aisha (Eng): Shuttle frequency? I might need to come from downtown on demo day.

Sam (People Ops): Shuttle runs 7:45am inbound and 6:20pm outbound. Seats limited; first-come sign-up. If demand spikes we9ll add an extra run at 8:00am.

Nora (People Ops): Pilot dates: Mon 3/1  Fri 3/12. We9ll reassess after week 1. Please only request exceptions when essential. Questions -> #people-ops or DM me. :thumbsup:
